# Sigstore verification fixture

`bundle-v03-dsse.sigstore.json` is the public Sigstore JS v0.3 DSSE test
bundle from:

<https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-js/blob/main/tests/bundles/bundleV03-dsse.sigstore>

It is retained under the upstream Apache-2.0 license and used only to exercise
cryptographic verification against the trust seed shipped by the official
Sigstore package. Bitveins-specific repository and workflow policy is covered
by separate synthetic statement fixtures.
